contract: The original published PHP SDK worker exits at the declared activity checkpoint. A separate cold published python 2.5.1 worker inserts the same patch ID twice, chooses false twice and completes the same activity and original run without a new marker or activity. Preserve all checkpoint bytes, original activity sequence 1 and the exact typed int64 result. Observe actual published SDK HTTP registration, completion and shutdown without modifying transport bytes. Embedded mode runs the corresponding original/replacement PHP author definitions and explicitly declares the language SDK direction inapplicable. This separately selected consumer profile leaves the frozen default and existing source/fault tuples unchanged. It does not qualify a live pending-history failure exchange, retained duplicate markers, fresh repeated marker creation or performance.
